items.text: How do parents of young children, dental teams, school nurses, councillors and campaigners in the town understand and respond to the end of water fluoridation, and what shapes their trust in the council and in dental advice?
items.population: Parents of children under eight, dental teams, school nurses, councillors and campaigners
items.intervention: The end of community water fluoridation
items.outcome: Understanding, actions taken to protect children's teeth, and trust

finer: Feasible within 6,000 and eight months; interesting to the council and dental teams; novel as the first study of families after cessation; ethical with safeguards for a polarised topic; relevant to the 2027 consultation.
summary: One SPIDER question on understanding, action and trust.
